# intunes.IT

> A lovingly snarky PSA correcting the common mistake of calling Microsoft Intune "Intunes". Not affiliated with Microsoft or Apple.

The correct product name is **Intune** or **Microsoft Intune** — never "Intunes". Microsoft Intune is a cloud-based MDM/MAM service for managing and securing devices, apps, and data. It is unrelated to Apple's iTunes, a media application for playing, purchasing, and syncing music and videos. The two are frequently confused because the names sound alike, but they are different products from different companies.

Built for fun by [scloud.work](https://scloud.work). Parody content; not official Microsoft or Apple documentation.
